snippet.description:
When you think about it, it’s pretty crazy that most places in the US aren’t walkable. And it turns out that many Americans agree with that sentiment. Vox’s Marina Bolotnikova explains why the US is built for driving and how some people want to see that change. 

Read the full article: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/502209/america-cities-walkability-surveys
